tasks.title: Telegram ingestion: analysed messages must not be sent again
tasks.outcome: Find why an already analysed Telegram message was sent again, and fix it in the product or in the check.
tasks.goal: Diagnose and, when the cause is provable from the repository, fix netbka/Dyk#455: on a disposable SQL database, app/scripts/verify-telegram-ingest-sql.js:215 ('analysed messages are not sent again') sees 4 messages where 3 are expected, reproduced on unchanged main 16067a3b. Read the full issue with gh issue view 455 --repo netbka/Dyk. Trace the ingestion and extraction path that decides whether an already analysed Telegram message is sent for analysis again (the ingest code, its SQL statements and procedures, migrations, and what the verifier inserts and asserts). Decide from the code whether the defect is in the product contract or in the verifier's expectation, citing file:line evidence. If the product is wrong, fix it with a focused test that runs without SQL Server; if the verifier is wrong, correct it and explain why the product behaviour is the intended contract.
constraints: Repository-only: you cannot run the SQL suite here. State plainly that the SQL contract run remains unverified, and give the exact command the owner or a release session must run on a host with the disposable SQL image.
If the cause cannot be proven from the repository, do not guess a fix: return blocked-owner-reserved or evidence-unavailable with the exact missing evidence, so the task stops instead of retrying.
acceptance: The report names the root cause with file:line evidence, or precisely the evidence that is missing.

Any change is minimal, follows the nearest AGENTS.md, and comes with a focused test that fails before and passes after without SQL Server, plus Dyk's required non-SQL checks for the touched files with exact commands and results.
